inconsistencies: Chain: #35646 (remove M_ERROR, route fatal errors through util::Expected) explicitly unblocks #35570 (return BlockValidationState by value). Review #35646 first; #35570 will need rework otherwise.
Chain: #36603 (loadtxoutset pipeline) is the stated base for #35054 (P2P UTXO set sharing). #36603 first.
Chain: #35861 (Testnet 5 / BIP 95) sits on top of #35793 (BIP 54) and activates its rules from block 1. #35793 must be settled first.

Chain: #35906, #36066 and #35569 are all preparatory steps toward the stateless validation library (#35904). #35906 is the one that carries actual validation-semantics change and should be reviewed first; the other two are mechanical follow-on.

Direction conflict: #36598 proposes removing AssumeUTXO entirely while #36543, #36500, #36542, #36346, #36702 and #35054 all invest in it. A maintainer decision on AssumeUTXO's future affects the value of all of them; the bug fixes (#36346, #36702) should proceed regardless.

Overlapping area: #36452 (false corruption from missing undo data) and #36702 (snapshot block treated as linked on startup) were found in the same review thread and both touch assumeutxo/pruned startup paths; expect interaction, review #36702 (crash) first.

Overlapping error-handling surface: #34132, #35003, #36049, #35731, #36318 and #36555 all restructure how validation reports I/O and failure states, and #35646 removes the runtime-error state they build on. Coordinating #35646 with #36318/#36555 avoids rebasing churn.

Overlapping code: #35751 and #36496 both modify CoinsViewOverlay prevout prefetching; #35751 carries the actual benefit and should be reviewed first, #36496 is an unmeasured micro-optimization on top.

Same problem class: #31989, #32247, #29247, #36122 and #35793 are all non-mainnet implementations of proposed consensus changes; they were previously spread across P1/P2 without a distinguishing reason and are now banded together.
result.notes: The P2 band is large because this category genuinely contains many substantive items (storage-error correctness, measured IBD/pruning speedups, and five proposed-soft-fork implementations); they are ordered so concrete bug and performance work precedes the non-activated consensus proposals. Several entries (#32427, #35187, #35557) are kernel-motivated but were kept here because they change block-index persistence, the ConnectBlock entry path, or validation time sources; #35187 in particular is mostly kernel API surface and would be better split so the validation part gets focused review.
